reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: This app no longer works. It's updated my phone is updated and nothing matters. It will not open. it gets stuck "finishing up". It opened one time and then it failed record the history of my meditation. The search function does not work. Nothing happens when you enter something

reviews.title: Look of the app is worse.
reviews.text: The latest update makes the text smaller and reduces the visual contrast between text and background. It’s harder for me to see and makes it seem like the app is targeting to a younger audience.

reviews.title: Another downgrade mislabeled upgrade
reviews.text: Just “upgraded” to lose favorites again with the new edition. Why does Happier cut material I’ve come to rely on every supposed upgrade? Not Happier about that.

reviews.title: NOT WHAT YOU THINK
reviews.text: This used to be my favorite app but when they split with Dan Harris, it became a scam. Don’t waste your money!! Support Dan Harris!! Go to the 10% App!

reviews.title: OMG "DEVELOPERS" ARE YOU EVEN READING THE REVIEWS?
reviews.text: 👉WOW! I AM NOT THE ONLY USER WHO HATES THE ENFORCED "CHECK-IN PAGE👈 I am one of the top users—the app doesn't even have milestones for the amount of consistency and milestones I've reached. I am grateful to Dan Harris for creating this and really sad to hear that he split with the co-founders due to creative and financial differences 💔 I have complained to support over the past year about the invasive "check-in" page and they had at least changed it to opt-out—but nope, not anymore!   I guess maybe they are using it to collect health & wellness data of users 🤔. I emailed them to ask them to return the "Skip" option and they said they hadn't removed it. I am an experienced Beta tester for apps with 20 years' experience. I realize that it's popular to add check-ins make the user feel "personalized" but this number of complaints? Nope. Cancelling my subscription and following Dan Harris over to "10% Happier With Dan Harris"

reviews.title: This is not Dan Harris’s app
reviews.text: Through listening to Dan Harris’s podcast, I recently discovered he parted ways with this “Happier Meditation” (previously 10% Happier) app in 2024. Hence the name change. I could be wrong, but it seems that this app continues to regurgitate his content and profit off of his success. I hope I’m wrong. In any case, If you want the real deal and more than just the ghost of Dan Harris, download and try “10% with Dan Harris.”

reviews.title: just another money, grabbing scam
reviews.text: avoid this one. It leads you through 10 time wasting minutes of happy happy, joy, joy, and then at the very end. Says, oh wait! You gotta give us 99 bucks. what a bummer.
